title: React Outlet – Lahore
desc: The idea was to create a contemporary design that is one of its kind. Sharp straight lines in dark tones are used for design which is set against the background of delicately curved panels in softer tones making the display stand out but at the same time balancing it as well. Each frame for display is customized specifically for a purpose making sure to display all varieties of merchandise, from short and long garments to shoes and accessories.
challenges: Creating a unique contemporary retail design that stands out in the market
Balancing sharp straight lines with delicate curved panels without visual conflict
Designing custom display frames for diverse merchandise including garments, shoes, and accessories
solutions: Developed a contrasting design system using dark tones for structural elements and softer tones for background panels
Created purpose-built display frames tailored to different product categories ensuring optimal presentation
Implemented strategic lighting to highlight merchandise while maintaining the design aesthetic

title: ZAK Shinwari – Sialkot
desc: The idea behind this luxury fine dine was "Renaissance". A fusion of culture with modernism. Culture may or may not directly effect our architecture. It depends upon how we approach it. The food of Afghanistan is now served in modern luxury interior so you can enjoy it whilst forgetting the dark times.
challenges: Fusing Afghan cultural elements with modern luxury interior design
Creating a Renaissance-inspired atmosphere that honors tradition while embracing contemporary aesthetics
Designing a space that helps diners enjoy the experience while moving past difficult historical associations
solutions: Integrated traditional Afghan architectural motifs with modern materials and finishes
Created a sophisticated color palette that reflects cultural heritage while maintaining luxury appeal
Designed an immersive dining experience that celebrates the cuisine and culture
